title: C. V. Raman's birth chart
metaDescription: C. V. Raman's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 15.3° Scorpio. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Four of the nine placements whose signs are settled fall in mutable signs, the widest weighting the unknown hour leaves certain. The mutable signs hand one season to the next; a chart weighted there is built for transitions.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: 15.3° of Scorpio is the Sun's exact seat — second decan, 10°–20°, sub-ruled by Jupiter in the old triplicity scheme. The degree is the address; the sign is only the street.

blocks.title: The fast planets
blocks.text: Closer in, Mercury stands at 2.6° Scorpio; Venus stands at 16.0° Sagittarius; Mars stands at 11.1° Capricorn. The tradition reads thought steeped in tone and memory from Mercury, attraction declared rather than implied from Venus, effort banked steadily until it tells from Mars.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: The day's firmest angle joins Saturn and Uranus — a sextile holding at 0.5°. Sextiles are read as standing invitations — productive exactly as often as they are accepted. Behind it, Venus sextile Uranus at 3.3°, and Venus trine Saturn at 3.8° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. All of it stands whatever the hour was: each angle was tested from midnight to midnight before it was written down.

blocks.title: What the angles build
blocks.text: The Moon makes no major aspect that survives the day; the old reading gives such a planet autonomy — it acts alone, sometimes loudly.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: Read against the old dignities, three placements stand out. Mars in Capricorn at 11.1° is in exaltation — the tradition’s honoured-guest placement, working at its best; Jupiter in Sagittarius at 10.3° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules; Saturn in Leo at 19.8° is in detriment — the planet opposite its home, working against the grain. Dignity is a statement about conditions, not about worth.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Balance, counted honestly across the 9 placements whose signs hold for the whole day: elements fire 3, air 3, water 2, earth 1; modalities mutable 4, fixed 3, cardinal 2. Mercury, Neptune and Pluto were retrograde — motion that reverses only from this vantage point, and which the old reading treats as delay used for revision.

blocks.title: The Moon is genuinely open
blocks.text: The Moon crossed from Sagittarius into Capricorn during that day at the birthplace, travelling 14.6° between one midnight and the next. Half the day belongs to each sign, and the split falls at an unrecorded hour — so this page holds the Moon as a genuine unknown.
